title: Kalo Launches All-in-One Health & Nutrition Tracker for Android
summary: Kalo combines calorie tracking, AI meal planning, exercise monitoring, and psychological wellness tools into a single Android app.
content: Kalo is a comprehensive health, nutrition, and fitness tracking app that integrates the entire health journey into one platform. Unlike competitors that focus on a single area, Kalo combines multi-API food search (FatSecret, Edamam, OpenFoodFacts, USDA), AI photo food recognition using Google Gemini 2.0 Flash, calorie and macro tracking, meal planning with recipe libraries across 7 cuisines, real-time exercise tracking with wearable sensor support, and a unique psychology module featuring an AI Coach, Craving Decoder, and Emotional Eating Detector. The app also includes cycle tracking for women's health, intermittent fasting timers, body composition tracking with progress photos, and a gamification system with challenges and leaderboards. Built with Java and Kotlin, Kalo integrates with Samsung Health, Huawei Health Kit, and Health Connect for accurate active calorie data. Available now on Google Play with a freemium model offering Free, Plus, Pro, and Pro Bundle tiers.

title: UK News Now: A Personal Safety App Disguised as a News Reader
summary: UK News Now provides covert evidence gathering, an AI companion, and encrypted vault features behind the appearance of a standard news app.
content: UK News Now is a personal safety and wellbeing app disguised as a standard UK news reader. Behind the news headlines lies a secure, private space designed to support individuals navigating difficult circumstances, particularly domestic abuse and narcissistic abuse survivors. The app appears as a normal news reader to anyone who might check the user's phone, with real news content from BBC and other UK sources via NewsAPI. Only the user knows the hidden functionality: an encrypted evidence vault for photos, audio, and documents; a private journal with photo and voice entries; an AI companion powered by OpenAI GPT-4o with ElevenLabs voice for emotional support; a personal safety plan builder; quick-access emergency contacts including the National Domestic Abuse Helpline; and covert recording capabilities. Built with React Native and Expo, the app features a 4-tier subscription model (Free, Bronze, Silver, Gold) with Google Play Billing. Available now on Google Play.

title: Write AI Brings 7 AI Writing Tools Plus ATS Scoring to Android and Web
summary: Write AI combines cover letter generation, resume optimization, LinkedIn summaries, follow-up emails, cold emails, essay writing, and will drafting in one GPT-4o powered app.
content: Write AI is a multi-tool AI writing application powered by OpenAI's GPT-4o, combining 7 specialised writing tools, an application tracker, and ATS keyword scoring into a single app available on both Android and Web. The 7 tools include a Cover Letter Generator with 5 tone options and 14 language outputs, a Resume Optimizer that rewrites resumes to match job descriptions with ATS keyword matching, a LinkedIn Summary Generator with 4 styles, a Follow-Up Email Writer for post-interview emails, a Cold Email Writer for sales outreach, a Research and Essay Writer supporting 5 document types and 4 writing styles, and a Will Writer that drafts complete Last Will and Testament documents. The app also features a Kanban-style Application Tracker and ATS Keyword Scoring that shows match percentages against job descriptions. Built with Next.js 14, Tailwind CSS, and TypeScript, with a native Android version powered by Capacitor. Available on Google Play and the web.

title: MindScape Brings Neuroscience-Based Mental Wellness to Android
summary: MindScape uses clinically-researched binaural beats, vagal nerve stimulation, and somatic trauma release to regulate the nervous system.
content: MindScape is a neuroscience-based mental wellness app that uses clinically-researched binaural beats, vagal nerve stimulation, and somatic trauma release to regulate the nervous system. Unlike generic meditation apps that offer guided meditations with celebrity voices, MindScape is built on peer-reviewed neuroscience. Every session targets specific brainwave states and neurological pathways proven to reduce stress and anxiety. The app features precision-engineered binaural beat technology across Delta, Theta, Alpha, and Beta frequencies, advanced 250Hz vagal nerve stimulation protocols, somatic trauma release sessions based on polyvagal theory, strobe light visual entrainment with adjustable intensity, adaptive soundscapes that learn from mood history, and personalised assessment playlists. With 50+ sessions across 8 categories including Anxiety and Stress Relief, Deep Sleep and Insomnia, Trauma Release, and Breathwork Protocols, MindScape is designed for users dealing with anxiety, sleep issues, trauma recovery (including C-PTSD), and those seeking peak mental performance. Available now on Google Play.

title: KC Legacy Booking: Preserve Your Family Stories for Future Generations
summary: KC Legacy Booking lets users create a digital repository of family histories, photos, and heirlooms to preserve their legacy.
content: KC Legacy Booking is a mobile app designed to help families preserve their legacy and pass it down to future generations. The app allows users to record and organize family histories, photos, and heirlooms in a single digital repository, tackling the problem of fragmented memories scattered across old photo albums and dusty attics. With customizable profiles, multimedia storage, and intuitive sharing capabilities, KC Legacy Booking ensures that family stories are safe and accessible for years to come. Whether you are a parent looking to preserve your children's childhood memories or a grandparent seeking to share your life experiences, KC Legacy Booking provides the tools to document and protect your family story.

title: Camp Compass: Your Outdoor Navigation Companion
summary: Camp Compass provides directional guidance and location tracking for campers, hikers, and outdoor enthusiasts.
content: Camp Compass is a navigation tool designed for outdoor enthusiasts and campers. The app provides directional guidance and location tracking to help users navigate trails, campsites, and outdoor adventures with confidence. Whether you are hiking unfamiliar trails, setting up camp in a remote location, or exploring new outdoor destinations, Camp Compass keeps you oriented and on track. Available now on Google Play.

title: App Stream: A Curated Collection of Thoughtful Mobile Apps
summary: From health tracking to personal safety, AI writing to neuroscience-based wellness, App Stream delivers apps that genuinely help their users.
content: App Stream is a curated collection of mobile apps built with care and clarity. Rather than chasing trends or maximising engagement metrics, each app in the App Stream catalogue is designed to genuinely help its users. The current lineup includes Kalo, an all-in-one health and nutrition tracker with AI food recognition; UK News Now, a personal safety app disguised as a news reader; Write AI, a 7-tool AI writing assistant with ATS scoring; MindScape, a neuroscience-based mental wellness app; and KC Legacy Booking, a family legacy preservation tool. Every app is built with a privacy-first approach, keeping user data where it belongs. New apps are added regularly, each crafted to solve a real problem without unnecessary clutter or tracking.

title: Kalo AI Photo Food Recognition Can Identify Your Meal in Seconds
summary: Kalo 4-tier AI recognition chain uses FatSecret, Edamam, and Google Gemini 2.0 Flash to identify food from photos and estimate nutrition.
content: One of Kalo's standout features is its 4-tier AI photo food recognition chain. When you snap a photo of your meal, the app first tries FatSecret Image Recognition against its verified database of 14M+ foods. If no match is found, it falls back to the Edamam Vision API, then to Google Gemini 2.0 Flash, a multimodal AI that can identify specific dishes like Chilli con Carne rather than just Stew, and estimate portions and nutrition. If all AI tiers fail, users get a manual entry fallback. This means you can photograph your plate and get accurate calorie and macro data in seconds, without typing anything. Combined with the barcode scanner for packaged foods and multi-API unified search, Kalo makes food logging faster than any competitor on the market.

title: UK News Now AI Companion Provides 24/7 Emotional Support Discreetly
summary: Powered by OpenAI GPT-4o and ElevenLabs voice, the AI companion offers real-time emotional support from within a seemingly normal news app.
content: One of UK News Now's most powerful features is its AI companion, available on the Silver tier and above. Powered by OpenAI GPT-4o with voice interaction via ElevenLabs TTS, the companion provides a real-time WebSocket voice connection for users to process thoughts, get coping strategies, and find emotional support at any hour. The AI is discreetly accessed from within what appears to be a standard news app, meaning users in vulnerable situations can seek support without arousing suspicion. The companion is available 24/7, offering a listening ear when human support may not be accessible. Combined with the app's encrypted journal, evidence vault, and safety planning features, UK News Now provides a comprehensive support system for individuals navigating domestic abuse and narcissistic abuse situations.

title: Write AI Resume Optimizer Beats ATS Systems with Smart Keyword Matching
summary: Write AI scores your resume against job descriptions, identifies missing keywords, and rewrites content with strong action verbs to pass Applicant Tracking Systems.
content: Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) reject up to 75% of resumes before a human ever sees them. Write AI tackles this problem head-on with its Resume Optimizer and ATS Keyword Scoring features. The Resume Optimizer rewrites your resume to match any job description, optimising for ATS with keyword matching, using strong action verbs, and quantifying achievements, all while keeping information truthful. The ATS Keyword Scoring feature scores your content against the job description, shows a keyword match percentage, and identifies missing keywords so you know exactly what to add. Combined with the Cover Letter Generator (5 tones, 14 languages) and the Kanban-style Application Tracker, Write AI gives job seekers a complete toolkit from application to interview. The app also saves your last 10 generations for easy reuse, and offers a dedicated student discount tier, making it the only AI writing app with a student-specific plan.

title: MindScape Somatic Trauma Release Helps C-PTSD Survivors Where Meditation Apps Cannot
summary: Using 4.5Hz theta waves with 528Hz Solfeggio carriers, MindScape somatic sessions gently discharge stored tension based on polyvagal theory.
content: Most meditation apps offer breathing exercises and calming sounds. MindScape goes much further with its Somatic Trauma Release sessions, which combine 4.5Hz theta waves with 528Hz Solfeggio carrier frequencies to address trauma at a neurological level. Based on polyvagal theory, these sessions help restore the Ventral Vagal Complex, gently discharging stored tension and bypassing cognitive blocks that traditional talk therapy and meditation cannot reach. Sessions include Safe State, Freeze Release, Amygdala Calm, and Somatic Trauma Release, each with 5-level intensity ratings from Gentle to Extreme. This makes MindScape particularly valuable for users dealing with C-PTSD and trauma recovery, who often find generic meditation apps ineffective or even triggering. The app also features Vagal Nerve Stimulation using 250Hz carrier waves, the exact frequency used in medical VNS studies, to reduce inflammation and activate the parasympathetic nervous system. Available on Google Play with a free tier and premium subscription.
